The '''2014–15 Danish Superliga''' season was the 25th season of the [[Denmark|Danish]] [[Danish Superliga|Superliga]], which decides the [[Danish football championship]].

Since [[Denmark]] dropped from fifteenth to nineteenth place in the 2014 UEFA association coefficient rankings at the end of the 2013–14 season, only the champion of the league qualified for the [[UEFA Champions League]]; that club would commence its campaign in the second qualifying round. Furthermore, the second and third-place clubs would now enter the [[UEFA Europa League]] in the first qualifying round.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://kassiesa.home.xs4all.nl/bert/uefa/data/method4/crank2014.html|title = Please update your bookmarks}}</ref>

==Teams==
[[Aarhus Gymnastikforening|AGF]] and [[Viborg FF]] finished the [[2013–14 Danish Superliga|2013–14 season]] in 11th and 12th place, respectively, and were relegated to the [[2014–15 Danish 1st Division|2014–15 1st Division]].

The relegated teams were replaced by [[2013–14 Danish 1st Division|2013–14 1st Division]] champions [[Silkeborg IF]] and the runners-up [[Hobro IK]].

On 17 July 2014, the national stadium and home to [[FC København]] changed its official name to Telia Parken due to a [[Sponsor (commercial)|sponsorship]] agreement with [[Telia Company|Telia]].<ref name="berlingske-business-parken-skifter-navn-til-telia-parken">{{cite news|last1=Overgaard |first1=Katrine |title=Parken skifter navn til Telia Parken |url=http://www.business.dk/digital/parken-skifter-navn-til-telia-parken |access-date=20 May 2017 |publisher=[[Berlingske]] Business |date=17 July 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170520001154/http://www.business.dk/digital/parken-skifter-navn-til-telia-parken |archive-date=20 May 2017 |language=da |url-status=dead }}</ref>
